QuestInfo.name: Ominous Sign
QuestInfo.0: #bCategory: Resurrection of Rex the Hoblin King - Escort, Party Quest#k\r Type: Prerequisite Quest\r\n Content: The delusions of Shammos seem to be getting worse after he recovered a portion of his memory.
QuestInfo.2: You've been asked to find out the location of the seal from #bRobeira#k, the Magician Job Instructor, and to go confirm it's still in place...
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 14,050\nCan proceed to the 'Confirming the Seal' quest\n

0.0: Friend. I am going crazy! I cannot stop thinking about Rex! Please help me. Please! \r\n#L0##bShammos... Are his delusions simply getting out of hand or is something really about to happen?#l\n#k

yes.0: I'm still at the basement of the Chief's Residence in El Nath.

no.0: Are you... Are you going to just watch me go crazy? Really?

1.0: I've been seeing visions of Rex every single day. Please, you have to help me! \r\n#L0##bShammos, forget about Rex. He's gone.#l\n#k
1.1: I can't! I'm frantic with worry! His voice just gets stronger and stronger. I'm going crazy! You have to go make sure he's really sealed. You have to! Robeira will know where he is. Please, I beg you. \r\n#L0##bYou're putting me in a tough spot... Roberia isn't going to like this.#l\n#k
1.2: Just check that he's still sealed. That won't hurt anyone, and I'll go crazy if you don't check for me! I'm so worried that he's resurrected somehow!

yes.0: Robeira will know. Please go see Robeira!
